links.outcome: Susceptibility classification sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy against culture and E-test.
links.effect: Pooled across three antibiotics, before versus after optimization: sensitivity 92.9% versus 100.0%, specificity 71.0% versus 74.2%, and accuracy 77.8% versus 81.0%. Classification errors remained after optimization.
links.quote: Pooled across the three antibiotics, sensitivity was 92.9%, specificity 71.0% and accuracy 77.8% before optimization; after optimization sensitivity rose to 100.0%, specificity increased slightly to 74.2% and accuracy to 81.0%.
